files.justification: GATE 4 default: proposed axis/theme-utility cluster is called BY the rendering cluster (_render_line/_render_area/_render_dual call _apply_theme/_apply_labels/_parse_x_values/etc.), which fails the GATE 3 independence requirement (clusters must not call each other). Single shared responsibility: render line/area/dual-axis charts to matplotlib figures.
GATE 4 default: line_count=216 < 350. Single responsibility: convert raw JSON dicts into typed ChartSpec objects.
